description: This file contains utility functions for computing daily and weekly progress statistics for a to-do list application. It includes functions to get the start of today and the week, check if timestamps are within a range, and compute counts of tasks created and completed within the current day/week.

methods.name: startOfToday()
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the start of the current day (00:00:00).

methods.name: startOfWeek()
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing the start of the current week (Monday 00:00:00).

methods.name: isInRange(ts, start, endExclusive)
methods.description: Checks if a timestamp (in ms) is within the specified start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) range.

methods.name: computeProgressStats(todos = [])
methods.description: Calculates counts of tasks created and completed today and this week based on an array of task objects.
